prompt.system_instruction: You are designing a modular natural-language executable procedure collection. Follow the latest modular-procedures section of the handoff. Divide every major evaluation into its own separately named procedure with explicit purpose, input ownership, operations, returns and dependencies. This pass produces complete module specifications and an orchestration manifest, not another monolithic original-length rewrite. Return one valid JSON object.
prompt.heuristic: Read all configured sources completely. Ask why every part exists. Include all distinct responsibilities: provenance verification, user-instruction capture, state-transition specification, mode selection, projection publication, pre-execution validation, execution, invocation audit, continuation selection, final-state verification, completion evaluation and final-response validation. Discover additional major evaluations when justified. Keep shared definitions single-owned; distinguish owned inputs from references. Use the common input/question/return/few-shot template in each procedure specification. Do not invent executed operations or metrics. Preserve the original eventual verbosity requirement for the assembled implementation, without padding this design pass.

output_schema.procedures: Separate complete module specifications, each with its name, separate proposed file path, why it exists, question/decision, locally owned inputs, references, evidence/operation, returned values, dependencies, failure handling, completion criteria and common template/examples.
output_schema.orchestration_manifest: Ordered calls and dependency relationships, including audit across the turn and continuation loops.
output_schema.shared_definition_ownership: One owner for each shared semantic concept and captured variable; references elsewhere rather than duplicated definitions.
output_schema.source_requirement_coverage: Map every distinct original and handoff requirement to one or more justified procedures; identify missing requirements or unresolved decisions.
output_schema.next_implementation_steps: Generate, persist and validate separate procedure files individually, then validate the assembled composition.

prompt.template_prefix: MODULAR DESIGN PASS: separate purpose-driven procedures for every major evaluation.
prompt.template_suffix: Return agents_modular_procedure_design. Do not generate another giant monolithic procedure or reuse the superseded full-rewrite return schema as this design pass's output contract. Design every module concretely so it can be implemented individually.
